provenance.change: Motion feedback repair, explicit mode companions, and selected-pregrasp admission where prepared grasp is exposed.
provenance.aperture_ceiling: revision 15 raises the published grasp.plan gripper_opening_m ceiling from the 0.055 literal to the value grasp.ALOHA_NOMINAL_MAXIMUM_OPENING_M derives from the pinned ALOHA URDF and config. Revision 14 kept the compiler and the published schema on two independent numbers, so once the compiler admitted a wider candidate the whole grasp_plan call died on its own result schema. The two earlier component files are untouched, so every manifest still pinning them delivers what it did.
provenance.controlled_point_projection: revision 17 declares view_config.controlled_point_projection per_camera_pixel_v1 and binds the robotwin-live observe and image result schemas, as robotwin_placement_explicit_motion_v3 and robotwin_placement_closed_skills_v1 have since 2026-09-25: every public camera entry says where each arm's public TCP lands in that image (the ALOHA TCP is outside both wrist images). The live schemas only add controlled_point_pixels to the revision-16 ones; nothing else changes. This surface became the RoboTwin default on 2026-09-30 (integration 0053) without the projection; the earlier component files are untouched, so every manifest still pinning them delivers what it did.
provenance.support_height: Revision 17 declares target_support_height_v1: vision localization adds a single-view support-plane estimate (support_z_m, height_above_support_m, mid_height_z_m, support_point_count, support_height_basis) and the vision help says center_xyz_m is a visible-surface median while mid_height_z_m is the side-grasp height reference. The producer measures the fields beside the principal frame; surfaces without the capability have them removed at projection.
provenance.revision_18: Integration 0055 joins the two independent revision-17 successors of revision 16: the development line's controlled_point_projection (TCP projection, H200 delivery) and EXP11A g004's target_support_height_v1. Their changes touch disjoint fields; revision 18 carries both unchanged.
provenance.null_optional_arguments: Revision 19 (EXP11B, 2026-10-02) declares optional_argument_null_as_omitted_v1 (agent/composition/null_optional_arguments.py): every optional member at every depth of every tool's input also accepts null -- its type gains "null" (and its enum null) and its description ends 'Null means omitted.' -- while required members and members that already accepted null keep their bytes; the final delivered tool list (including artifact_read and observe's ref mode) gets the same rule and every root union is delivered flat. The Native and managed gateways drop null optional members recursively before classification and dispatch, so the handler sees them omitted and a null arm of a per-arm targets map is never commanded; a placeholder value is still judged as a value. EXP11A g016 (EXP11B g003): the Codex gateway decoded these tools as strict, so GPT-6 Astra filled every optional geometry_query property on all 160 calls, inventing region [0,0,1,1] and world_points_m [[0,0,0]] for the unused operations, and the handler refused all 153 that reached it; step, already nullable, was the one it left null. No component file, worker or kernel file changed.
provenance.description_consistency: Revision 20 (EXP11B, 2026-10-03) binds robotwin_toolchain_b2_closed_noservo_v1-description-consistency-help-v1.json and robotwin_toolchain_b2_closed_noservo_v1-description-consistency-schemas-v1.json: this surface's own composed help and input schemas with exact sentence edits, so the shared files the old sentences live in, and every frozen surface that binds them, keep their bytes. geometry_query no longer says missing depth fails the call -- a points entry returns valid false, region_result reports valid_count 0 and a projected point carries null scene_depth_m, all inside a successful result (agent/tools/robot.py _geometry) -- and its mark_point near miss, like mark_point's own Effect, says a disagreement beyond 25 mm fails that entry with error_code inconsistent_mark and keeps the stored measurement (mark_point_batch.execute_batch) instead of calling it a refusal. max_candidates states its default as a value rather than as an omission, now that null also means omitted, and so do geometry_query.window_px and align_plan.standoff_m. move_pose, move_to, rotate_pitch and rotate_wrist replace their four-sentence copy of compute's Use when with a one-sentence pointer to it, move_to and recover_pose state the immediate return before the later receipt, and vision_ground drops the 'raise it from one' advice that contradicted its default of three. grasp_plan keeps 'Reachability is delegated to move_pose or grasp_execute': this surface does not declare grasp_plan_ik_reachability_annotation_v1, so grasp_plan runs no IK. No capability, result schema, worker or kernel file changed; Chinese reference in docs/reference/public-interfaces.md#tool-description-consistency.
provenance.compute_grammar: Revision 20 (EXP11B, 2026-10-03) also declares compute_grammar_from_evaluator_v1 (agent/composition/compute_grammar_schema.py, tables in agent/tools/compute_grammar.py): the compute description ends with one generated section stating the statements, operators and forms the evaluator admits, the constructs it refuses by name, the reserved names, the attributes of a produced value and the exponent rule; the evaluator's refusals read the same tables. EXP11A g016: GPT-6 Astra wrote p[2] = ... (7x), p[2] += ... (1x) and np.diag (1x) against a description that named none of them.
